points: Flat, well-demarcated pink, red or purple patch, often unilateral and following a dermatome-like segment.
With age: darker colour, thickening and **cobblestone** nodules (vascular blebs), soft-tissue overgrowth.
Blanches partly on pressure; does not grow out of proportion.

cards.name: Salmon patch (naevus simplex)
cards.clue: Pale pink, midline (nape, glabella, eyelids); fades in the first years

cards.name: Infantile haemangioma (see Infantile haemangioma)
cards.clue: Absent or faint at birth, then rapid growth and involution

items.t: Facial segmental port-wine stain with eye or neurological symptoms (seizures, glaucoma).

pearls.t: A malformation is not a tumour: be clear with parents whether it is a PWS or a haemangioma.
PWS does not fade; salmon patches do.

quiz.q: Name a red flag that needs escalation.
quiz.a: Facial segmental port-wine stain with eye or neurological symptoms (seizures, glaucoma).
